answer: Each PoA task binds a participant’s prior commitment to a domain-separated hash of a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse. Because the pulse is unpredictable until released, a node cannot precompute answers or farm a cache offline; commit-reveal then exposes and verifies responses against the same seed. Rotating prompts—perhaps asking for sonnet, island, or wander—make recycled work detectable, raising the cost of automated Sybil swarms without claiming to eliminate identities.
